name: PT Hutama Karya Infrastruktur
description: PT Hutama Karya Infrastruktur is a construction subsidiary of state-owned Hutama Karya, specializing in toll roads and bridges, including sections of the Trans-Sumatra Toll Road.

name: Monee Indonesia
description: Monee is the digital financial services arm of Sea Limited, providing payments, lending, and digital banking through products such as ShopeePay and SeaBank across Southeast Asia.

name: PT Astra International Tbk
description: PT Astra International Tbk is an Indonesian diversified group with businesses in automotive distribution and manufacturing, financial services, heavy equipment, mining, and agribusiness.

name: Odoo
description: Odoo develops open-source business applications for CRM, sales, accounting, inventory, and operations, used by companies worldwide through its Belgium-based software platform.

name: PT Hutama Karya (Persero)
description: PT Hutama Karya (Persero) is a state-owned Indonesian construction company responsible for the Trans-Sumatra Toll Road and other road, bridge, and building projects.

name: PT Zurich Indonesia Tbk
description: Zurich is a global insurance group whose Indonesian business provides life and general insurance products for individuals, families, and companies.

name: Paragon Corps
description: ParagonCorp is an Indonesian cosmetics and personal-care manufacturer behind brands including Wardah, Make Over, Emina, and Kahf, sold domestically and in export markets.

name: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk
description: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is a state-owned Indonesian bank providing consumer, business, and corporate banking services through branches and overseas offices.

name: Polygon
description: Polygon is an Indonesian bicycle brand manufactured by PT Insera Sena in Sidoarjo, producing mountain, road, and urban bikes for domestic and export markets.

name: PT Nindya Karya (Persero)
description: PT Nindya Karya (Persero) is an Indonesian state-owned construction company working on roads, bridges, buildings, and water infrastructure projects across the country.

name: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk
description: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk develops industrial estates and real estate, builds commercial and infrastructure projects, and operates hotels in Indonesia.

name: PT Outward Bound Indonesia (OBI)
description: PT Outward Bound Indonesia is an outdoor education provider and member of Outward Bound International, running experiential leadership, team-building, and character programs for schools and companies.

name: BLIBLI
description: Blibli is an Indonesian e-commerce platform operated by PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk, selling electronics, household goods, and groceries alongside travel and lifestyle services.

name: UGM Online
description: UGM Online is Universitas Gadjah Mada's open online learning platform, offering certified micro-credentials, MOOCs, and short courses to learners in Indonesia and abroad.

name: Direktorat Kemahasiswaan
description: Direktorat Kemahasiswaan is Universitas Gadjah Mada's student affairs directorate, managing scholarships, student welfare, counseling, and support for student organizations and activities.

name: PT Torrecid Indonesia
description: PT Torrecid Indonesia is the Indonesian subsidiary of Spain's Torrecid Group, supplying glazes, frits, inks, and digital decoration solutions to ceramic tile and glass manufacturers.

name: APP Group
description: APP Group is an Indonesian pulp, paper, and packaging producer under the Sinar Mas group, supplying tissue, board, and packaging products to customers worldwide.

name: PT Cobra Dental Indonesia
description: PT Cobra Dental Indonesia is a Yogyakarta-based distributor of dental equipment and materials, operating outlets across Indonesia and supplying brands such as 3M, GC, and W&H.

name: PT Elnusa Petrofin
description: PT Elnusa Petrofin is a fuel logistics subsidiary of Elnusa, part of Indonesia's Pertamina group, handling fuel transportation, storage, and distribution across the archipelago.

name: PT Dynapack Asia
description: Dynapack Asia is an Indonesian rigid-plastic packaging manufacturer producing bottles, caps, jars, and components for consumer, pharmaceutical, and industrial customers across Asia.

name: Teach First Indonesia
description: Teach First Indonesia is a non-profit that recruits young professionals and graduates to teach for two years in underserved Indonesian schools, providing training and leadership development.

name: OCBC
description: OCBC is a Singapore-based banking group whose Indonesian arm, Bank OCBC NISP, offers consumer, small-business, and corporate banking services across the country.
